That's clear. I ticked the boxes on the pasta recipe and the "living with presence" article, and both got a highlighted outline so I can see at a glance which ones are picked, a count told me how many I'd selected, and a batch-action bar slid in at the bottom once I had something chosen. That combination leaves no doubt about what's in my group and what I can do to them together. Having the boxes sit there quietly during normal browsing and the action bar only appear once I've selected something feels unobtrusive — it's not in my way when I'm just looking around.

One thing I'll flag for when you build this out, not a knock on the selection itself: the action bar here offers **Add tags** and **Archive selected**. Those are the two I'd reach for most, so good — but when I'm tidying in bulk I'd also expect to be able to do the other group things to a batch, like marking them read-later (or done) and deleting a selection. I don't need every button demonstrated right now, but I'd want the batch actions to eventually cover that same tidy-up range, not just tagging and archiving. For now, show me the second selection version to compare.
